I used to be a gamer, spending most if not all of my time in front of the screen playing a wide variety of computer- and video games.

Nowdays I have a full time job and I’m going back into Uni. I no longer have as much time to play games and when I do I don’t want the time to be wasted.

I have a STEAM library full of games I haven’t played and to get a reason to play though them I thought I could make short reviews for the users like me who would like to play something new but doesn’t want to invest tens of hours in a game before finding it fun and awarding.

I thought four hours of gametime before reviewing the game sounded like a good idea. It should get me into the core of the game and make me able to review how the game is after a few short sessions with it.

How does this sound? Is there any interest in watching short reviews of the first few hours of a game? Anything specific you would like me to cover that isn’t in quicklooks such as ”WTF is...”?
Reviews covering the first 4 hours of gametime. Interest?

It's always nice to see other gamers playthrough a portion of the game which can help you make a better informed decision about purchasing the game or not. Go for it mate, but just remember to at least bring out the quality of the video. I don't want to watch a playthrough of someone screaming or talking about something totally irrelevant.
Absolutely. I'm not that kind of person. I'll try to record something and have it ready by the weekend.
